items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: we brought him to the Civic Center in Syracuse where he played with us, with the Central New York Jazz Band

ctx.x: Yeah. And she is a good drummer.

She’s a great drummer. When Clark Terry — of course my ambition when I moved to Syracuse, I said to my wife, I says, “I’m going to get Clark to play with me in Syracuse.” And it took a few years. Finally I called Clark up and I said, “I want you to play with the band.” He says, “Okay, when?” And he was very sick with diabetes. He got off the plane in a wheelchair, and we brought him to the Civic Center in Syracuse where he played with us, with the Central New York Jazz Band. And he absolutely killed the crowd. Of…
Yeah. That was a great event. You guys did a good thing there with that orchestra.
